Whisper is an experimental encrypted tool. You are participating in an early access program and may encounter bugs or performance issues. Please share your feedback to help us improve!

Experience a new era of messaging where your privacy isn\'t an option—it\'s the foundation. Whisper is a stealthy, decentralized communication layer designed for those who value absolute discretion and modern aesthetics.

Grow your network organically through "Mutual Connection" mapping. Whisper identifies potential friends through shared circles, allowing you to connect with your community without ever touching your contact list or exposing your personal metadata.

Every syllable is guarded by industrial-grade P-256 Elliptic Curve cryptography. Your encryption keys are generated locally and never transmitted, ensuring that your conversations remain mathematically impossible for anyone else to intercept.

Break free from the password era. Whisper uses locally hashed, one-way security tokens. No email, no trackers, and no central database to leak. In Whisper, you aren\'t the product—you are the architect of your own digital identity.

We are sorry, but the engine encountered an error while processing your files.
Our engine is built on a custom native integration of FFmpeg, ensuring desktop-class performance and support for hundreds of legacy and modern codecs entirely offline.

Performance mode utilizes hardware-accelerated encoders (MediaCodec) when available, focusing on speed. Quality mode uses software-based Lanczos scaling and high-bitrate libx264/libx265 for maximum fidelity.
No data ever leaves your device. All processing happens locally in isolated background services. We don\'t use cloud APIs, protecting your sensitive media from third-party servers.
The engine manages a concurrent queue, automatically handling multiple file types in a single session. It intelligently routes images, videos, and PDFs to specialized sub-engines.
